svg.title: Frame jitter vs universes
svg.desc: Realistic mixed load, normal priority. One output frame in a hundred comes at least this far apart.
svg.text: Realistic mixed load, normal priority. One output frame in a hundred comes at least this far apart.
Hollow marker: jitter or broken. Frames are due every 20 ms; median of the runs at each count.
